blogs.title: Beyond Floating Points: Welcome to the Era of 1.58-Bit AI
blogs.description: An introductory guide to BitNet b1.58, explaining how replacing complex 16-bit numbers with simple ternary values (-1, 0, 1) allows LLMs to maintain high performance while drastically reducing their computational footprint.

blogs.title: AI on Your Phone? How 1-Bit LLMs Solve the Memory Crisis
blogs.description: A deep dive into the practical implications of BitNet b1.58 for edge computing. This post explores how the massive reduction in memory usage and energy consumption paves the way for running powerful, high-quality LLMs directly on mobile devices and CPUs.

blogs.title: Cutting the Energy Bill: The Path to Sustainable AI
blogs.description: A focus on the environmental and economic impact of LLMs. This post explains the shift from floating-point multiplication to integer addition, highlighting how 1-bit LLMs can save up to 71 times the energy used in matrix multiplication.

blogs.title: The New Scaling Law: Why 'Bigger' is Now More Efficient
blogs.description: An analysis of the surprising efficiency trade-offs discovered in the paper, explaining the counterintuitive reality where a 70B 1.58-bit model can actually be faster and cheaper to run than a 13B full-precision model.
